name: National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students - Scholarship (formerly Top Class Education for Scheduled Tribe Students)
provider: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India

rules.quote: ST students of the 265 Institutions, which are identified by Ministry of Tribal Affairs as Top Class Institutions are eligible for the scholarship under the scheme.

value: 265 Top Class Institutions notified by MoTA
rules.quote: ST students of the 265 Institutions, which are identified by Ministry of Tribal Affairs as Top Class Institutions are eligible for the scholarship under the scheme.
The total family income of the student to be eligible for this scholarship from all sources should not exceed Rs.6.0 lakh per annum.

rules.value: income = gross income of both parents; spouse income added if married
rules.quote: In case of married candidates, the spousal income will also be added to compute total family income.

rules.value: income certificate once at admission; increase later does not bar renewal
rules.quote: Income certificate is required to be taken once only i.e. at the time of admission to courses which are continuing for more than one year.
Any one-time assistance, such as for a laptop, will not be repeated if it has already been availed.

amount.text: Full tuition and non-refundable fees (ceiling Rs 2.50 lakh p.a. in private institutes), books Rs 5,000 p.a., stipend Rs 3,000 per month, computer Rs 45,000 one-time (Rs 86,000 misc for fresh, Rs 41,000 renewal)
amount.quote: There will be a ceiling of Rs. 2.50 lakhs per annum per student for private sector Institutes. 2. Books & Stationery @ Rs.5000/- per annum per annum per student without bills/vouchers. 3. Stipend @ Rs.3000/-per month

documents.name: Family income certificate from State competent authority (not notary)
documents.quote: Income Certificate: Fresh applicants should upload latest family Income certificate for the year 2025-26

documents.name: ST community / PVTG certificate
documents.quote: ST Community/PVTG Certificate signed and stamped by Competent Authority (Certificate signed by Notary is not valid).

documents.name: Bank passbook copy
documents.quote: Scanned Copy of the Passbook clearly showing the account number and name of the student

documents.name: Marksheet of last academic qualification
documents.quote: Scanned Copy of Marksheet of Last Academic Qualification
